repository_method_precedents.use: Sections1 and3 re-read: locally nilpotent functional-preserving shears and transport of all fixed mixed sequences. Haar preservation is re-proved here, not imported from a Gaussian contour argument.
Retained precedent separating pure-nullity, a nullcone obstruction and eventual mixed safety. No new SIC classification is claimed.

principal_source.authors: Henrik Seppanen and Valdemar V. Tsanov
principal_source.title: Geometric invariant theory for principal three-dimensional subgroups acting on flag varieties
principal_source.selected_passages_read: Section1.2, Proposition1.1, alpha(h0)=2 on simple roots, restriction formulas and Lemma1.3.
principal_source.imported: Classical principal triple existence and normalization. Strict extremal weights, the real Cartan component, replica preservation and separating invariant are proved in the new note.
principal_source.not_imported: Flag-variety GIT quotient, unstable-locus or codimension conclusions.

finite_group_source.use: Printed215 E7/E8 generators identify the canonical examples. Exact cyclotomic generation, group orders, compactness, projective orders, form invariance and invariant dimensions are independently computed by the checker.
finite_group_source.boundary: The general Haar-shear proof does not require finite-subgroup classification.

general_classical_inputs: Affineness for reductive stabilizers; compatible compact forms and dense compact stabilizer.
Complete reducibility, Cartan components, highest/lowest weights and Chevalley root relations.
Duistermaat--van der Kallen for the positive connected torus case.
Retained GVC2FTS finite-trace separation for the disconnected toral case.
new_general_construction: A star-stable nontrivial real Cartan module supplies highest p and q=pstar. A normalized principal lowering F has F^n p/n!=q. Phi_t=exp(t qF) preserves Reynolds. The invariant I=h((pi_mu P)^(n+1) pi_(n+1)mu P) takes value t^n h(|p|^(2n+2))!=0 off t0.
concrete_controls: Exact cyclotomic groups48/120; self-transvectants; independent Casimir/Omega projections; first resonant pure moments5/7 directly zero; positive Haar norm sums and sharp-marker endpoints; principal SL3 triple.
logical_boundary: The constructed pure-null elements are eventually marked-null, so they settle nullcone detection, not Mathieu--Zhao failure. A nonzero fixed marked tail is still required for that problem.
additional_controls: Extremal lowering of degree-ns markers and direct Haar norms independently confirm the sharp endpoints. Replacing the invariant coefficient q by p makes pF fail Haar preservation,detected by h(pF((Fp)star))=-h(|Fp|^2)!=0.
